title: Hiking With Baby Printable Guide, Toddler Hiking Checklist, Family Hike Planner, Baby Carrier Packing List, Gift for New Parents PDF
description:
Hiked before the baby came and want to keep going? This 24-page guide helps you plan family hikes with a baby or toddler (up to about age 4): slower, shorter, more stops, and a happy family at the end of the day. All four seasons in one file, with checklists you can tick off at the door.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Your first family hike: how to pick a short, easy trail with an exit, bathrooms and shade
- Carriers by age: wrap, soft structured and frame carriers, with a fit check you can tick (always follow your carrier maker's rules)
- When toddlers walk: realistic distances and games that keep them moving
- The parent pack and a printable baby and toddler packing checklist
- Dressing for warm days and cold days
- Feeding, snacks, water, diapers, potty breaks and packing it out
- Naps on the trail and timing the hike around them
- Bugs, ticks and plants, weather and turnaround rules, trail safety with little ones
- First aid kit additions for kids, each season at a glance, a car kit for after the hike
- Fill-in pages: family hike planner, our first hikes log, milestones page and a night-before and at-the-door checklist

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Not medical advice. Ask your pediatrician about sun protection, insect repellent and cold weather for your child. Follow your carrier maker's age, weight and fit rules. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
